title: Rare Eurasian lynx spotted in Sikkim, confirming broader presence in eastern Himalayas
summary: A rare Eurasian lynx has been photographed in Sikkim's Tso Lhamo plateau, marking the second photographic record of the species in the region. This finding follows a 2025 record in Arunachal Pradesh and highlights the need for conservation efforts to protect the wild cat's habitat.
summary_points: A rare Eurasian lynx has been photographed in Sikkim's Tso Lhamo plateau
This is the second photographic record of the species in the eastern Himalayas
The finding confirms the broader presence of the wild cat in the region
Conservation efforts are needed to protect the lynx's habitat
The discovery highlights the importance of preserving biodiversity in the eastern Himalayas
